claims.observation: Cap occupies the top ~20% of total height (width-profile step at frac~0.20-0.25)
Cap diameter measured ~0.795x body diameter (330px / 415px at stable rows)
Distinct dark-green band ~frac 0.21-0.26 of height, at the cap/body diameter step
Body silhouette width varies only ~2.6% (408-419px) across frac 0.30-0.95 of height -- measured directly, not eyeballed; see body_width_ratio_obs
Width drops sharply only in the last ~2% of height, consistent with a rounded/filleted bottom edge on a separate unpainted steel band starting at frac~0.92

dimensional_anchors: total_height=30.8cm (official spec, used as the pixel-to-cm scale anchor)

claims.observation: "3.62 x 3.62 x 12.13 in." (diameter x diameter x height) -- circular cross-section, single diameter value for the whole bottle, no separate widest-point callout

conflicts.description: Photo-measured body diameter (~8.6cm, derived from pixel width using total height as the sole cm/px scale anchor) is ~6% narrower than the official spec diameter (9.2cm).
conflicts.resolution: Adopted the official spec (9.2cm) as authoritative for absolute scale -- a single-axis height-anchored pixel-to-cm conversion of a cross-axis measurement is expected to carry several percent error from crop/lens/edge-detection imprecision, while the manufacturer's own listed diameter is a direct measurement. The photo's INTERNAL proportional ratios (cap/body/base relative to each other and to total height) remain used as-is, since ratios measured within the same photo are far less sensitive to this error than an absolute cross-axis conversion would be.
